tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The brand colour, exact: the logo blue by default. Decorative and brand surfaces only (the cover, illustrations). Never carries text: black on it is 6.1:1 but only APCA Lc 42, and white on it is 3.5:1. Use `primary` for anything interactive.

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: The second brand colour, exact: the logo green by default. Decorative and brand surfaces only. Never carries text: white on it is 2.2:1.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Action blue: the fill of the primary Button and of every selected or checked state (selected day, page, segment, time slot, checkbox, switch), with `on-primary` (white) text at 7.2:1. Also small blue text and links on `surface` and `surface-tint` (7.2:1 and 5.3:1), the information tone, and the filled part of progress and loading bars. A deep teal derived from the logo blue (`brand`) so that white text passes WCAG AAA.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: White text and icons on `primary` fills (7.2:1).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: The information tone: text, outline and icon of a neutral notice. Same colour as `primary`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backdrop of an information chip, notice or toast: the pastel brand tint, so an information notice reads apart from a neutral one (`surface-tint`). `info` holds 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: `primary` with the hover shade mixed in: the hovered fill of a primary action or selected state.

tokens.name: primary-press
tokens.usage: `primary` with the press shade mixed in: the pressed fill.

tokens.name: primary-slab
tokens.usage: `primary` with the slab shade mixed in: the colour of the raised bottom edge under a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Where you are: the pastel brand tint on `surface`, the face of the selected tab, the current nav item, the current step, the days inside a calendar range and the information tone's backdrop. The middle step of the ladder: hover is the neutral `wash-hover`, where you are is this tint, and a value you set is filled `primary` on its slab. Built from `brand`, so it is the logo's own colour, softened: never further than 1.2:1 from `surface`, so a saturated brand stays a tint; `defineTheme` gives up strength until `ink` (7:1), `muted` and `primary` (4.5:1) hold on it.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Action green: the fill of the secondary Button (a positive action), with `on-secondary` (white) text at 7.2:1. Derived from the logo green (`brand-accent`). The success tone is `success`, so an `accent` of another hue leaves it green.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: White text and icons on `secondary` fills (7.2:1).

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: `secondary` with the hover shade mixed in.

tokens.name: secondary-press
tokens.usage: `secondary` with the press shade mixed in.

tokens.name: secondary-slab
tokens.usage: `secondary` with the slab shade mixed in: the raised bottom edge under a secondary fill.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: A faint tint of the `accent` hue, for your own surfaces next to a secondary action. The success tone's backdrop is `success-soft`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The success tone: text, outline and icon of a positive status (paid, saved, done) on `surface` (7.0:1) and `success-soft`. Derived from the `success` input of `defineTheme`, apart from `secondary`, so a brand `accent` never recolours it.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backdrop of a success chip, stamp, notice or toast.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger red: the fill of the danger Button, with `on-danger` (white) text at 8.3:1. Also the danger tone's text and outline, error text and invalid input edges, on `surface` (8.3:1) and `danger-soft` (7.1:1). Derived from the `danger` input of `defineTheme`: deepened until `on-danger` text reaches 7:1.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: White text and icons on `danger` fills (8.3:1).

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: `danger` with the hover shade mixed in.

tokens.name: danger-press
tokens.usage: `danger` with the press shade mixed in.

tokens.name: danger-slab
tokens.usage: `danger` with the slab shade mixed in: the raised bottom edge under a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backdrop of a danger chip, stamp, notice or toast.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: The warning tone: small amber text, outline and icon on `surface` (7.8:1) and `warning-soft` (7.1:1): AAA. Derived from the `warning` input of `defineTheme`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backdrop of a warning chip, stamp, notice or toast.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page ground: the colour behind everything, painted by the app shell and the page. White by default, the same as `surface`. The `background` input of `defineTheme` sets it; when only `surface` is given the page ground follows the surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: What sits on the page: cards, fields, popovers, dialogs, panels and headers. Every screen starts on white. The `surface` input of `defineTheme` sets it, and with it derives `surface-tint`, the soft tone backdrops and, on a dark surface, the light action colours.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: The surface's second step: wells, hovered rows, table headers, footers, empty slots and the information tone's tint. Derived from `surface` by shifting its lightness 0.1 toward the foreground (0.06 the other way on a dark surface), in the brand hue: chroma 0.02 in light and dark themes (never more than the brand has; a neutral grey with `contrast: "high"`). About 1.3:1 against white, so never a boundary on its own.

tokens.name: surface-paper
tokens.usage: The statement: a paper-coloured surface for the one document-like block on a screen (a bill, a receipt, a form to sign). A hair warmer than `surface` and drawn with the `shadow-paper` shadow. Derived from `surface`.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: The resting fill of a loading placeholder (skeleton, empty bar track). Faint enough to read as absent.

tokens.name: slab-ink
tokens.usage: The neutral slab: the edge and the raised bottom under a face that has no fill colour of its own (an outline button, a tag, a key, an expandable row, a floating panel), and the sunk edge of a quiet control toggled on (`shadow-sink`). The same as `border-strong` (4.5:1 on `surface`), so a neutral face's edge and its slab are one colour and a sunk state always shows. A theme may set it apart; keep it 3:1 on `surface`. Fills use their own `*-slab` colour.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and icons on `surface`, `surface-tint`, `primary`, `secondary`, `danger` and the soft tints. Also the neutral chip colour. Set by the `foreground` input of `defineTheme`, which also drives `muted`, `border` and `border-strong`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline link text on `surface`, `surface-tint` and `background` (5.3:1 or better by default). Same colour as `primary`; a theme may set it apart.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons of a disabled control. A disabled control is also drawn with a dashed edge, so the colour is never the only cue.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: The face of a disabled control.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: The highlight behind selected text (`::selection`). Derived from `surface` and the brand hue; `ink` on it holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: stamp-ink
tokens.usage: The ink of a rubber stamp: a warm vermilion for the one mark on a page that says a thing is final (PAID, SIGNED, VOID). Use it rarely, once per screen. Holds 7:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: wash-hover
tokens.usage: The one hover fill: a transparent wash of the `surface-tint` pigment (the colour that is exactly `surface-tint` at 50% over `surface`) for rows, items, tiles, quiet buttons and the selected nav item or tab, so the ground beneath shows through. On a plain ground a hovered row is the tinted ground; on one that is already tinted (a striped row, a segmented track) it is one step deeper. 50% by default; `defineTheme` gives up strength on a ground where `ink`, `muted` or `primary` would lose contrast on it. Where the fill must be opaque (a sticky cell), lay it over the surface: `background: linear-gradient(var(--e-wash-hover), var(--e-wash-hover)) var(--e-surface)`.

tokens.name: wash-press
tokens.usage: The one pressed fill: one step past `wash-hover` (75% of the same pigment), fitted the same way: `defineTheme` gives up strength where `primary` text would fall under 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: wash-ring
tokens.usage: The transparent edge of a hovered quiet control.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed backdrop behind a dialog or drawer: a deep shade of the brand colour at 55%, so it follows the theme. Black on a dark surface and with `contrast: "high"`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, kickers and captions on `surface` (7.9:1, AAA) and `surface-tint` (5.9:1). Close to the grey of the logo's tagline. From a `foreground` input, `ink` softened toward `surface` until it just holds 7:1 (15:1 with `contrast: "high"`).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, the outline of cards and popovers, and the underside of clickable rows. 3.4:1 on `surface` and 3.2:1 on `surface-tint`, so every edge is visible on white. Control edges use `border-strong`. From a `foreground` input, `ink` softened toward `surface` until it just holds 3.4:1; `ink` itself with `contrast: "high"`.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and other control borders on `surface` (4.5:1, above the 3:1 floor). From a `foreground` input, `ink` softened toward `surface` until it just holds 4.5:1; `ink` itself with `contrast: "high"`.

tokens.name: shell-rail
tokens.usage: The line down each side of the `EAppShell` content column, beside the content only. `transparent` turns it off.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus outline with 2px offset on buttons, links, tabs, rows and every control that is not a text input; 3:1 or better on every surface and fill.

tokens.name: focus-field
tokens.usage: The focus outline and edge of text inputs and everything built on them (Field, Select, Combobox, DatePicker, NumberField, SearchBar, OtpField). Primary blue, 7.2:1 on `surface`. An invalid input keeps `danger`. Buttons and links use `focus-ring`.

families.sans: "Bricolage Grotesque", "Bricolage Grotesque Fallback", "Avenir Next", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Geist Mono", "Geist Mono Fallback", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title. Set `letter-spacing: var(--e-tracking-tight)` with it.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title. Set `letter-spacing: var(--e-tracking-tight)` with it.

styles.name: deck
styles.usage: The one-sentence reading of a statement: what it is and what to do next.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy, 62 characters wide at most.
styles.sample: Pay online in about a minute.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Table cells, helper text, secondary copy.

styles.name: helper
styles.usage: Help, error and description text under a field or a choice, and breadcrumbs: small copy on a 20px line.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase mono labels, and the text inside chips and stamps. Set `letter-spacing: var(--e-tracking-label)` and `text-transform: uppercase` with it.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: One line of small mono metadata that is not a label: the date beside a signature, a file hint, a range count.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: The count after a label (a tab, a nav item): small strong mono figures on a 20px line.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Amounts, counts, statement numbers and dates in a row. Tabular.

styles.name: numeral-l
styles.usage: The one amount a statement card leads with.

type.note: Each style is a token: `font: var(--e-type-<name>)` sets weight, size, line-height and family together. Tracking is separate (`letter-spacing: var(--e-tracking-label)`), because the `font` shorthand cannot carry it. Sizes are rem, line-heights unitless.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, gap inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, default gap, side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: A step of the scale that no component uses, kept for one-off layout needs of your own.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between related groups and parts of a statement.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: A step of the scale that no component uses, kept for one-off layout needs of your own.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: A step of the scale that no component uses, kept for one-off layout needs of your own.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small parts: stamps, tags, keys, checkboxes, the switch, the slider, tooltips, highlighted code and skeleton lines.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, notices.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: The corner of a row or a small part inside a `radius-md` panel or box: a menu item, an option, a step, the dot of a step. The panel's radius less `pad-inset`, so the row rounds almost as much as the panel and the two read as one shape (6px in an 8px panel). Inside a bordered box (the clear button of a field, a chip in a multi-select, a colour swatch) take the border off too: `max(0px, calc(var(--e-radius-row) - var(--e-stroke-edge)))`.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: For your own large surfaces; no component uses it. Dialogs and drawers use `radius-md`, like cards, so one corner setting rounds everything alike.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The count on a tab or nav item and the scrollbar thumb, echoing the logo's round caps.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: A circle: avatars, radio buttons, dots and thumbs.

shadow.note: Box shadows, each named `shadow-<role>`: the three materials (`shadow-frame` flush, `shadow-well` sunk, `shadow-float` raised off the page), the statement edge and the hover and press rings.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: The frame: the flat outline of everything that is not clickable: cards, summaries, the SearchBar. A `stroke-card` ring in `border` (3.4:1 on white), no depth. The ring is written with `var()`, so a `border` or `stroke-card` override reaches every card.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Sunk: inputs, tracks, meters and empty slots pressed into the page, a shade along the top inner edge. Drawn in the same deep shade as `shadow-float`, so every shadow of a theme has one hue.

tokens.name: shadow-drop
tokens.usage: The one wide, faint drop under a floating panel, in the theme's deep shade: the lift of `shadow-float` without its ring and slab. Set by `elevation`.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.value: 0 0 0 var(--e-stroke-card) var(--e-border), 0 calc(2 * var(--e-depth)) 0 var(--e-stroke-card) var(--e-border), var(--e-shadow-drop)
tokens.usage: Raised off the page: popovers, menus, list panels, tooltips' larger cousins, dialogs and the command palette. A floating panel is a slab lifted off the page: its `stroke-card` ring in `border`, a hard bottom edge twice `depth` deep in the same `border`, so edge and slab are one piece as a button's are (at twice a button's lift), and `shadow-drop`. Nothing in the flow of the page uses it. Written with `var()`, so a `border`, `depth`, `stroke-card` or `shadow-drop` override reaches it. A toast, whose tone edge marks it already, has no slab: a plain ring over `shadow-drop`.

tokens.name: shadow-sink
tokens.usage: Sunk, for a quiet control toggled on (a pressed icon button, a revealed password): the slab drawn inside the top of the face, `depth` deep in `slab-ink`, so the face reads as pushed in.

tokens.name: shadow-ring-hover
tokens.usage: The hairline ring of a hovered item with no fill: use it with `wash-hover`. Drawn inside the box, so layout does not move.

tokens.name: shadow-ring-press
tokens.usage: The ring of a pressed item: `ink` at the same width as the hover ring, so pressing darkens the edge it hovered with. Use it with `wash-press`.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: The statement edge: the `stroke-card` ring in `border` plus `shadow-well`, for a `surface-paper` block that reads as a sheet laid on the page.

fontSize.note: One scale for every piece of text, in rem so the browser's font-size preference applies. Components read these; nothing sets a size in raw pixels.

tokens.name: text-xs
tokens.usage: Kickers, chips, stamps, micro labels and other mono labels. Never smaller.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, table cells, helper text, small buttons.

tokens.name: text-md
tokens.usage: Body copy, input text and button labels. Inputs must stay at 16px or more so phones do not zoom in on focus.

tokens.name: text-lg
tokens.usage: The deck: a one-sentence reading of a statement. Calendar headings.

tokens.name: text-xl
tokens.usage: Card and panel titles (h3).

tokens.name: text-2xl
tokens.usage: Section titles (h2).

tokens.name: text-3xl
tokens.usage: The one amount a statement leads with.

tokens.name: text-4xl

size.note: Sizes that components share, each named `<thing>-<dimension>[-<step>]` (`control-height`, `icon-size-md`, `panel-width-sm`), and the tap target.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of every control, in rem so it follows the browser's font size, that can be tapped: buttons, inputs, selects, date fields, slots, and one row of a multi-select. One height everywhere, so a Button beside an input lines up and a field never shifts when it changes type.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target size, in px: a target is never smaller than this, whatever the font size. Compact controls pad or extend their hit area up to this size.

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: Height of a Chip or a small Stamp.

tokens.name: icon-size-sm
tokens.usage: The `sm` icon (14px), for chips and stamps.

tokens.name: icon-size-md
tokens.usage: The `md` icon (20px), the default box of an icon. Follows `textScale`, so an icon keeps its size next to its text.

tokens.name: icon-size-lg
tokens.usage: The `lg` icon (28px): the icon at the start of a notice.

tokens.name: icon-size-xl
tokens.usage: The `xl` icon (40px): the large icon of an empty state.

tokens.name: check-size
tokens.usage: The box of a checkbox or radio.

tokens.name: avatar-size-sm
tokens.usage: The small avatar.

tokens.name: avatar-size-md
tokens.usage: The `md` avatar, the default: the tap target (44px) at the default text size.

tokens.name: avatar-size-lg
tokens.usage: The large avatar.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest comfortable line of copy.

tokens.name: term-width
tokens.usage: The label column of `EDescriptionList`: about two kicker words wide. The labels stack above their values in a container under 26rem.

tokens.name: panel-width-sm
tokens.usage: Width of a small panel: a confirm dialog, a narrow drawer.

tokens.name: panel-width-md
tokens.usage: Width of a standard dialog, drawer or command palette.

tokens.name: panel-width-lg
tokens.usage: Width of a large dialog or drawer holding a form.

tokens.name: container-width-sm
tokens.usage: The `sm` page column of `EContainer`: a narrow column of reading or a single form.

tokens.name: container-width-md
tokens.usage: The `md` page column of `EContainer`.

tokens.name: container-width-lg
tokens.usage: The `lg` page column of `EContainer`, its default.

tokens.name: list-max-height
tokens.usage: The most height a list of options takes before it scrolls: about seven rows. The Select and Combobox panels, search results and the command palette's list. Capped at 60% of the viewport where it is used.

tokens.name: shell-width
tokens.usage: The widest the `EAppShell` content column, header and footer grow. Set it on the shell or on `:root`.

stroke.note: Line weights, and the gaps beside a line: a focus outline's, a field's and an underline's.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers and the rule between rows.

tokens.name: stroke-card
tokens.usage: The outline of a card, panel, table or other container that is not clickable, and of a chip or stamp. Follows the hairline; a bold elevation draws it at 2px unless `strokes.card` sets it.

tokens.name: stroke-edge
tokens.usage: The outline of a control, chip or stamp. The same as the hairline unless `strokes.hair` sets it (a whole number of pixels, rounded down from 1.5 times the hairline), so the border and the outline laid over it line up in every browser. Pin it through `tokens`.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus outline, and the gap between a control and it. One value for both, so the ring reads the same everywhere.

tokens.name: stroke-focus-gap-field
tokens.usage: Space between a text input and its focus outline: minus the control border, so the outline lies exactly over the border with no seam, whatever its width.

tokens.name: stroke-underline-offset
tokens.usage: The gap between text and its underline: links, breadcrumbs, a quiet button's label, a matched letter in an option. In em, so it follows the font size.

depth.note: The slab: how far the raised bottom edge under a face reaches. `depth` is the `depth` input of `defineTheme`; `depth-thin` and `depth-bold` follow it. Which a face takes follows its height.

tokens.name: depth
tokens.usage: The slab: how far the raised bottom edge under a control reaches (a button, a checked box at control size, the chosen day, the current page). Set by the `depth` input of `defineTheme` and by a preset (`ink` 3px, `quiet` 1px). Which of the three slabs a face takes follows its height: `depth-thin` up to `chip-height` (a key, a tag, a checkbox, a switch, a slider thumb), `depth` up to `control-height`, `depth-bold` only for a side edge that marks a tone. A floating panel stands on twice it (`shadow-float`).

tokens.name: depth-thin
tokens.usage: The slab of a part no taller than `chip-height`: a key cap, a tag, a checkbox or radio, the switch, a slider thumb. Half of `depth`, a whole pixel at least (`defineTheme` rounds it).

tokens.name: depth-bold
tokens.usage: The side edge that marks a tone: the inline-start border of a notice, a stamp or a toast, always `calc(var(--e-stroke-edge) + var(--e-depth-bold))`. Twice `depth`.

duration.note: How long state changes take. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the theme CSS sets `duration-tap`, `duration-fade` and `duration-move` to 0.01ms. A looping animation must switch itself off instead of using these.

tokens.name: duration-tap
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-fade
tokens.usage: Things that appear or fade where they are: every floating surface arriving (the shared pop-in of a popover, menu, list panel, tooltip, date panel, toast and dialog: a short drop onto its slab), a scrim, a collapsing region. Between `duration-tap` and `duration-move`.

tokens.name: duration-move
tokens.usage: Things that travel across the screen: a drawer sliding in, a progress fill, a switch thumb.

tokens.name: duration-loop
tokens.usage: One cycle of a looping loader: a skeleton pulse, an indeterminate progress bar.

tokens.name: duration-spin
tokens.usage: One turn of a spinner.

tokens.name: transition-state
tokens.value: background-color var(--e-duration-tap) var(--e-easing-out), box-shadow var(--e-duration-tap) var(--e-easing-out), border-color var(--e-duration-tap) var(--e-easing-out), color var(--e-duration-tap) var(--e-easing-out)
tokens.usage: The transition of a hover and press change: colours and rings over `duration-tap`. Write `transition: var(--e-transition-state)` on anything that answers the pointer.

tokens.name: easing-out
tokens.usage: Fast start, soft landing: the easing of every state change.

tokens.name: easing-enter
tokens.usage: Something arriving: a popover, drawer or toast opening. Decelerates into place.

tokens.name: easing-exit
tokens.usage: Something leaving: it accelerates away.

tokens.name: easing-linear
tokens.usage: Constant speed: a spinner and a striped bar.

zIndex.note: Layers above the page, lowest to highest. Native dialogs and popovers sit in the browser top layer and need none.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: A part that must sit above its sibling inside one component.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and columns.

tokens.name: z-focus

tokens.name: z-header

tokens.name: z-modal

tokens.name: z-popover

tokens.name: z-toast

tokens.name: z-tooltip

tokens.name: z-skip

weight.note: Three weights, all loaded by `fonts.css`. There is no bold: the browser would synthesise 700.

tokens.name: weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body copy.

tokens.name: weight-medium
tokens.usage: Headings, numerals and field values.

tokens.name: weight-strong
tokens.usage: Kickers, table headers and emphasis. Selection never changes weight (a selected tab, segment or page keeps its label's width); a chosen day or option, in mono or with room to spare, may. Button labels use `type-button`, at `weight-medium`.

layout.note: Semantic spacing: the roles of the `space-N` scale. Components read these, so one choice (a tighter toolbar, a roomier card) is made in one place and `spaceScale` and `density` still apply, because each is a reference to `space-N`. `space-N` itself is for one-off needs.

tokens.name: gap-tight
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label, inside a chip, between a label and its hint.

tokens.name: gap-snug
tokens.usage: Between siblings of a row or cluster: toolbar controls, a button group, a pagination bar, form action buttons. Also the least space between two tap targets.

tokens.name: gap-base
tokens.usage: Stack gap: between the blocks of a stack, a label and its control, the controls of a form row or a pager. The default gap (`EStack`).

tokens.name: gap-loose
tokens.usage: Field to field in a form, cards in a grid (`EGrid`), the parts of a dialog or card section.

tokens.name: gap-section
tokens.usage: Between groups of related blocks and between sections of a page. Larger breaks on a landing page use `space-8` and up directly.

tokens.name: pad-chip
tokens.usage: Inline padding of a chip, stamp or tag.

tokens.name: pad-control
tokens.usage: Inline padding of a text control (button, input, select, tab). Subtract the control's border: `calc(var(--e-pad-control) - var(--e-stroke-edge))`. A control's block size is `control-height`, never padding.

tokens.name: pad-control-sm
tokens.usage: Inline padding of a compact or quiet control, a menu item, a list row.

tokens.name: pad-cell
tokens.usage: Padding of a table or grid cell: block, then inline.

tokens.name: pad-card
tokens.usage: Padding of a card, summary, notice or any bordered container.

tokens.name: pad-panel
tokens.usage: Padding of a dialog, drawer, popover section or other panel.

tokens.name: pad-inset
tokens.usage: Half of `space-1`: the hairline gap between the label of an option and its description. Corners of nested rows use `radius-row`, which takes off the real inset.

tokens.name: gutter-min
tokens.usage: The side gutter of a page on a phone: the least space between content and the screen edge.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: The side gutter of a page: `gutter-min` on a phone, growing with the viewport to `space-12`.

tracking.note: Letter-spacing, in em so it follows the font size.

tokens.name: tracking-label
tokens.usage: Uppercase mono labels: kickers, chips, stamps, table headers.

tokens.name: tracking-tight
tokens.usage: Display type, where the default spacing looks loose: `h1` and `h2` and the large figures (`numeral-l`, a metric). Bricolage Grotesque's optical size axis tightens the letterforms at those sizes by itself; this closes the gaps between them.

leading.note: Unitless line-heights, so they scale with the font size. Lines land on a 4px grid where a style recurs: `leading-helper` gives text-sm a 20px line and `leading-chip` gives text-xs a 20px line.

tokens.name: leading-none
tokens.usage: One-line display figures. Not for text that wraps.

tokens.name: leading-tight
tokens.usage: Page titles, kickers and button labels.

tokens.name: leading-snug
tokens.usage: Section and card titles, numerals, helper text that wraps once or twice.

tokens.name: leading-normal
tokens.usage: Body copy and anything that reads as a paragraph.

tokens.name: leading-helper
tokens.usage: A 20px line for `text-sm` (on the 4px grid): help and error text under a field, a choice's description, breadcrumbs. Used by `type-helper`.

tokens.name: leading-chip
tokens.usage: A 20px line for `text-xs` (on the 4px grid): the count on a tab or nav item. Used by `type-count`.
